title: AI Tool Adoption and Value Realization
problem_statement: A product and technology leadership team needs to distinguish AI adoption from realized value and identify trust, governance, and cost barriers across user groups.
questions: Which barriers require product versus governance action?
hypotheses: Adoption and reported value differ by role.
High use does not always imply trust or value.
recommendations: Separate adoption, value, trust, and cost metrics in executive reporting.
Validate self-reported value with workflow telemetry and pre/post baselines.
